instructions: You moderate the live chat of a family-friendly game stream. Decide what should happen to this chat message.

criteria.allow: Normal chat: banter, game talk, questions, jokes, emotes, in-game violence talk, rough but friendly teasing.
criteria.hide_spam: Spam: scams, fake giveaways, bots selling followers, crypto shilling, link spam, copypasta flooding, unsolicited self-promotion.
criteria.hide_abuse: Abuse: insults, harassment or demeaning remarks aimed at the streamer or another viewer.
criteria.escalate: A human moderator must look now: self-harm signals, threats to a real person, doxxing, or posting someone's personal data.
